criteria.description: Create, read, edit, and reject unknown records through HTTP
Server rejects invalid values and malformed JSON without mutation
Case-insensitive search and status/priority filters intersect
Records and edits survive a full server restart
Browser creates and edits records, matching server state
Browser search and filters update displayed records
Failed save shows an error and retains form input
Usable labeled controls at 390px and no horizontal overflow
Visible loading, empty and list-load error states
Invalid browser submission is rejected without losing inputs or mutating records
